label: preparing
what: Likely a privately funded gathering or celebration in the great hall, possibly marking my forty years as mayor, presented to me as an 18:00 lighting inspection. The substantial bread and lantern arrangements, Freight's payment to Innkeeper, coordinated grain sourcing, and exact attendance appointment suggest joint preparation. Secretary appears to help by arranging the appointment; knowledge of a concealed celebration is plausible but not established. The occasion itself remains uncertain.
